method.authoritativeUniverse: baseline-map unique current assignments; all seven report coverage tables required
evidenceRules: D = explicit key production branch deep-reading evidence, not exhaustive line coverage
E/B = equivalent diff review, not upgraded to D by tests/imports/path names
P = partial/selected reading; T = structural contract review
SD_OR_E = cross-report claims mix scoped deep reading and diff; conservative, no whole-file D upgrade
AST/import scanning in this ledger is metadata only and never counted as deep reading
runtimeInsufficientlyDeepReviewed = contains runtime statements but no primary/supplementary explicit D claim; E-only files are reported conservatively as deep-review gaps, not unread or defective
no new tests, probes, type-check, lint, application or broker execution
P/T focus: only direct runtime import edges count as consumer witnesses; pure-type intermediary edges do NOT prove transitive symbol/field usage and are not promoted to runtime reading evidence
all 245 runtime files have primary D or E/B; no substantive runtime file is only P/T/U or missing a primary entry
type-only P/T files are not runtime gaps themselves; direct runtime consumers and their report evidence are recorded separately
Original primaryCoverage/rawCoverageCounts remain immutable history; effectiveCoverage separately incorporates explicit supplements and prior cross-group D evidence
Latest update reads reports and existing metadata only; no production-source rereading or AST/import rescanning
G0-G5 direct consumption is descriptive, not a requirement for infrastructure-private contracts; all known direct runtime consumers now have D evidence
limitations: report statements are evidence of claimed reading depth, not independent observation of every prior read tool call
static relative-import graph is not complete dynamic-consumer or symbol-level proof
no semantic approval, final independent re-review, exhaustive state/line coverage, or behavior equivalence verdict
unpaired provenance and low-threshold rename/manual owner candidates remain provenance uncertainty, not proof of removal/new business
private infrastructure contracts may have G6-only deep-read consumers; absence of G0-G5 direct D is recorded, not misreported as business group approval
source AST scans are metadata-only, not a repeated business audit
Coverage completion does not change finding/authorization/independent-review status and is not exhaustive fields, states, concurrency interleavings, line coverage or behavioral-equivalence proof
